  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Untrusted job-log content is copied between fixed evidence delimiters without escaping an embedded closing delimiter, allowing attacker-controlled text to appear outside the intended fence.
  WHY: A job log can contain the closing marker followed by instructions that are then presented in the heal prompt; severity ranges from major to blocker, so the highest severity is used.

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The base64 fragment-slicing logic may fail to redact non-padded or partial credential fragments, and one review reports that short encodings can make the subsequent length check crash.
  WHY: A credential may remain recoverable in logs or the redaction pass may abort; assessments disagree on whether the current expression works for unpadded input and on severity, so the highest severity is used.

  PROBLEM: `verify_heal_scope` calls `.group()` on `HEAL_SCOPE_RE.search(body)` without ensuring the search returned a match.
  WHY: If the search returns `None` while the status is `verified`, the function raises `AttributeError` instead of returning a result.

  WHY: Consumer paths can be omitted from the scope marker, causing the consumer implement preflight to refuse the heal; severity ranges from major to blocker, so the highest severity is used.

  PROBLEM: Intake fetches full run metadata during provenance verification and fetches the same run metadata again during evidence collection.
  WHY: The duplicate REST read adds a call per run and a transient failure or changed response on the second read can discard an already verified run.
